item.title: Lakers fend off fiesty Warriors for third straight win
item.description: With both teams missing stars, the Lakers controlled much of the second half of Saturday’s game against the Warriors, earning a 105-99 win. item.title: Lakers sign Kobe Bufkin to two-year deal
item.description: The Lakers moved quickly after the trade deadline to sign their 15th and final player. On Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reported that the Lakers were signing Kobe Bufkin to a two-year deal with the second year being a player option. Bufkin had a brief 10-day stint with the Lakers, playing rotation minutes in two […]

item.description: When the NBA made the schedule, they probably had a much different game in mind than the one that played out on Saturday. item.title: Adou Thiero assigned to South Bay Lakers as part of return from injury
item.description: It’s been a season of inactivity for Lakers rookie Adou Thiero.
